what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Zimbabwe in South Africa: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2779 Zimbabwean asylum seekers in South Africa, 43.6% of all asylum seekers from Zimbabwe.
Refugees from Zimbabwe, a separate group, live mostly in South Africa, Ireland, Canada and the United Kingdom.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Zimbabwe, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2007 to 2008 and 2011 to 2016.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2001 at 6 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 55978, at the end of 2015, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in South Africa.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for South Africa only.
